title: Microsoft Cloud Engineer - Cayman Islands (Relocation)
description:
Microsoft Cloud Engineer – Cayman Islands (Relocation)

Permanent, Full-Time | £60,000–75,000+ Tax-Free Earnings Potential | Relocation Assistance

Considering a career and lifestyle change? We're recruiting an experienced Microsoft Cloud Engineer for an established and expanding IT services provider (MSP) in the sunny, tax-free Cayman Islands.

Based in George Town, Grand Cayman, this is a varied, hands-on role working with business customers across Microsoft 365, Azure and related cloud technologies, with opportunities to work on emerging Microsoft AI solutions.

You'll join an experienced international team that includes professionals who have relocated from the UK and elsewhere.

The Opportunity

You'll be involved in a broad range of technical and customer-facing responsibilities, including:

  • Designing, implementing and supporting Microsoft 365 and Azure cloud solutions.
  • Delivering Microsoft 365 migrations, Azure implementations and other customer projects.
  • Participating in solution design, pre-sales consulting, proposals and presentations.
  • Managing technical projects and providing escalated support for existing customer environments.
  • Working with customers to identify opportunities for improvements and new solutions.
  • Helping customers adopt and integrate emerging Microsoft AI technologies, including Copilot and AI agents.

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll bring as much as possible of the following:

  • 5+ years' experience supporting Microsoft technologies, particularly Microsoft 365, Azure and Windows Server.
  • 3+ years' experience working for an MSP or IT services provider.
  • Hands-on experience delivering Microsoft cloud migrations, implementations and infrastructure projects.
  • Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102) and Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) certifications, or equivalent expertise.
  • Experience in solution design, pre-sales consulting and customer-facing project delivery.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer requirements and projects.
  • Experience with Microsoft AI technologies, including Copilot, Azure AI or AI agents, would be a particular advantage, as would certifications such as AI-102, AI-103, AZ-305 or AB-100.

Compensation & Relocation

Overall earnings potential of approximately £60,000–75,000+ equivalent annually, with no income tax deducted. This includes a base salary, vehicle/fuel and on-call allowances, plus additional earnings opportunities through overtime and call-outs.

Employer-sponsored health insurance, pension, relocation assistance including initial temporary accommodation, and an employer-arranged work permit are also offered.

Beyond the role itself, this opportunity would particularly suit someone who is open to an international move and keen on experiencing the warm climate, lifestyle and tax-free earnings that living and working in the Cayman Islands have to offer.

Could this be for you?

Please apply in confidence or contact Jason Squires at Squires Partners for further information.
